userStories.title: KVM gate probe
userStories.description: As the operator, I want proof that one candidate host exposes `/dev/kvm` and runs a pinned `msb`. The spike then stops early when KVM is absent.
acceptanceCriteria: The probe runs on one agro-console free-tier node, created with `agro node create --spec n4 --free-tier`. The probe creates no paid resource.
`.agro/tasks/msb-base-image-spike/evidence/kvm-probe.log` records `ls -l /dev/kvm`, `msb --version`, and the output of `msb self doctor` on the A1 console node.
The log records the newest upstream `msb` release on the day of the probe as `<msb-version>`, and the sha256 of the installed binary.
If `/dev/kvm` is absent or `msb self doctor` exits non-zero, the advisor writes `blocked` in `prd.json` with the reason, and stories US-002 to US-006 do not start.
After the probe, `agro node list` shows no node that the probe created.

userStories.title: `agro-msb` build target
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want one `agro-msb` target in `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` so that the microVM arm uses the AGRO image plus the Docker engine recipe of `ryaneggz/microsandbox-ubuntu-dind`.
acceptanceCriteria: `.devcontainer/Dockerfile` defines a stage `agro-msb` that starts `FROM final`.
The `agro-msb` stage installs `docker-ce`, `containerd.io`, `docker-buildx-plugin`, and `docker-compose-plugin` from the Docker Debian repository.
The `agro-msb` stage writes `/etc/docker/daemon.json` with `"live-restore": true` and adds the `sandbox` user to the `docker` group.
The `agro-msb` stage enables `docker.service` under systemd and keeps `CMD ["/sbin/init"]`.
The `agro-msb` stage creates no user other than `sandbox` and sets no password.
`docker build --target agro-msb -f .devcontainer/Dockerfile .` exits 0.
The advisor pushes the `agro-msb` image as `ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:spike-msb-<sha>`. The release workflow does not change.
`docker build --target final -f .devcontainer/Dockerfile .` exits 0, and the existing image smoke test of `.github/workflows/release.yml` passes on the `final` image.
The stage holds no explanatory comment.

userStories.title: `msb` adapter for `/remote-sandbox`
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want an `msb` adapter so that `run.sh msb <check>` boots the `agro-msb` image as a microVM on the A1 console node through the existing driver.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/adapters/msb.sh` defines the five functions that `SKILL.md` § Adapter contract names, with the prefix `msb_`.
`msb_create NAME` runs `msb run --init auto --root-disk flat:40G "$IMAGE"` on the A1 console node over SSH and stores the sandbox ID in `$STATE_DIR/msb-NAME`.
`msb_exec NAME CMD…` runs `CMD…` in the guest under `timeout 120`.
`msb_restart NAME` runs `msb stop` on the stored sandbox ID. Next, `msb_restart NAME` runs `msb start` on the same ID.
`msb_destroy NAME` removes the guest, and `msb_list` prints the number of guests whose name starts with `agro-mx-`.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-adapters.test.ts` covers each `msb_` function with a stub `ssh` and a stub `msb` on `PATH`.
`bash -n` and `shellcheck` pass on `adapters/msb.sh`.
Typecheck passes.

userStories.title: microVM guest check
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want one check script with the microVM rows. Both arms then report Docker, persistence, and footprint results in the `RESULT` format.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/skills/remote-sandbox/checks/msb-guest.sh` emits one `RESULT <row-id> <PASS|FAIL|SKIPPED> <detail>` line for each row `M01` to `M06` in `## Summary`.
Each row runs when an earlier row fails. The script exits with the count of `FAIL` rows.
On a host-mode node, rows `M03` and `M05` print `SKIPPED` with the reason `no microVM`.
`bash -n` and `shellcheck` pass on `checks/msb-guest.sh`.
`.agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-suite.test.ts` asserts that the script prints one `RESULT` line for each row ID with stubbed commands.
userStories.notes: executed on integrated task branch: bash -n checks/msb-guest.sh exit 0; shellcheck v0.11.0 exit 0; npx vitest run .agro/scripts/__tests__/remote-sandbox-suite.test.ts 15/15 pass (worker red run: 7 failed before script existed); pnpm run typecheck exit 0. reasoned: one RESULT line per row M01-M06 per phase, exit=FAIL count, rows run after failures, host mode (MSB_GUEST unset) prints M03/M05 SKIPPED no microVM — asserted by the suite tests. Design: MSB_GUEST=1 marks microVM mode; MSB_GUEST_PHASE pre|restart|restore; MSB_IDLE_WAIT; IMAGE_SIZE_BYTES. msb_exec must forward these (US-003 repair round 1).

userStories.title: Run both arms
userStories.description: As the operator, I want three runs of each arm with the same checks so that the decision uses medians, not one sample.
acceptanceCriteria: Every run uses the console free tier. The runs create no paid resource.
Arm A0 runs `bash run.sh console agro-rows.sh` and `bash run.sh console msb-guest.sh` three times on `CONSOLE_SPEC=n4`.

Arm A1 runs `IMAGE=ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:spike-msb-<sha> bash run.sh msb agro-rows.sh` and `IMAGE=ghcr.io/mifunedev/agro:spike-msb-<sha> bash run.sh msb msb-guest.sh` three times on the A1 console node.
Arm A1 runs `scripts/restart-test.sh msb` three times.
The free tier allows one live node, so the runs execute one at a time. Each run deletes its node before the next run starts.
Each run writes its log under `.agro/tasks/msb-base-image-spike/evidence/`.
Both arms use the same `msb` release `<msb-version>` and the same AGRO commit.
After the last run, `agro node list` and `msb_list` show no node and no guest that the runs created.

userStories.title: Decision brief
userStories.description: As the operator, I want one brief that applies the decision rule to the medians. I then choose between HEAD and the microsandbox layer from evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/msb-base-image-spike/brief.md` holds one table with one column for each arm and one row for each row ID in `R01` to `R14` and `M01` to `M06`.
The table shows the median of the three runs for each timed row and the pass count for each other row.
The brief computes the cost per tenant for each arm with the formula in `## Summary` and cites a source for each price.
The brief states exactly one outcome: `proceed` or `stay on HEAD`, and names the rule clause that decides the outcome.
If the outcome is `stay on HEAD`, the task PR removes the `agro-msb` stage and `adapters/msb.sh`.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh .agro/tasks/msb-base-image-spike/brief.md` exits 0.

userStories.title: A0 node-reboot M03 check
userStories.description: As the operator, I want the M03 restart-persistence check run across an A0 node reboot so that M03 compares like events on both arms.
acceptanceCriteria: Three A0 runs on free-tier n4 nodes, one node at a time: msb-guest.sh with MSB_GUEST=1 MSB_GUEST_PHASE=pre on the node host, then sudo systemctl reboot, then wait for SSH, then msb-guest.sh with MSB_GUEST_PHASE=restart.
Each run records the M03 RESULT line, seconds from reboot to first SSH, and whether the AGRO sandbox container reports healthy after the reboot.
Each run writes its log under .agro/tasks/msb-base-image-spike/evidence/ and deletes its node; agro node list shows no live node at the end.
brief.md gains an A0 reboot column value for M03 and a note on how the result changes the M03 caveat; ste-check exits 0.
userStories.notes: executed: 3 A0 runs (a0-reboot-1-20261103-162614, -2-163036, -3-163526), one free-tier n4 node at a time. Advisor grep: M03-restart-persist FAIL (tmux_has_session=1) 3/3 on the node host; M03-container-tmux FAIL 3/3; reboot_to_ssh_s 26.6/27.2/26.6; reboot_to_healthy_s 35.0/35.3/35.0, health=healthy; docker active. agro node list: 0 live (26 destroyed). brief.md M03 row has the A0-reboot value, a findings paragraph, and the caveat line updated; ste-check exit 0.
